# omniddi_ipam_next_free_ip (Data Source)

Shows the next free addresses in a subnet without allocating them. The answer is advisory: nothing is reserved, and it changes as soon as the space is used. Use it for capacity checks in `check` blocks or for outputs. Do not pass it to a resource argument: the next plan reads a different answer and Terraform would replace the resource. To allocate an address, use the `omniddi_ipam_address` resource.

## Example Usage

```terraform
check "app_subnet_capacity" {
  data "omniddi_ipam_next_free_ip" "app" {
    subnet_cidr = "10.10.1.0/24"
    quantity    = 10
  }

  assert {
    condition     = length(data.omniddi_ipam_next_free_ip.app.addresses) == 10
    error_message = "Subnet 10.10.1.0/24 has fewer than 10 free addresses."
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `exclude` (Set of String) Addresses never to return, at most 100.
- `quantity` (Number) How many addresses to look for, 1 to 100. Defaults to 1. All or nothing: when fewer are free, `addresses` is empty.
- `subnet_cidr` (String) CIDR of the subnet. Set this, `subnet_id`, or both.
- `subnet_id` (Number) Id of the subnet. Set this, `subnet_cidr`, or both.

### Read-Only

- `addresses` (List of String) The lowest free addresses, in order. Empty when fewer than `quantity` are free.
- `ip_address` (String) The first free address, or null when none is free.
